data.title: 黑歌 · 榻榻米间的微醺猫耳舒展
data.description: 和室榻榻米上散落着精美的瓷酒壶，空气中飘着淡淡酒香。黑歌身穿一袭松散的黑色金边和服，衣领低垂露出如雪般白皙的胸口与锁骨。黑色猫耳随微醺的节拍轻轻扇动，修长双尾在身后妖娆摇曳。她半趴在草席上单手托腮，金色猫瞳带着魅惑的笑意，懒洋洋地发出甜软的小猫呼噜声。
data.location: private tatami room with overturned sake cup
data.action: 身穿一袭松散的黑色金边和服
data.lighting: warm amber floor lanterns casting flickering shadows across tatami
data.promptProse: Lounging lazily on her stomach across woven tatami mats beside a porcelain sake flask and tipped cup, Kuroka wears a luxurious black silk kimono with gold trim left loosely open around the collar. Propping her chin on one palm while her bare shoulders and full cleavage peek from the slipping silk, she gives the viewer a tipsy, teasing smile as warm floor lanterns cast flickering amber shadows across the quiet Japanese room.
data.animaCaption: Lounging on the tatami mats beside a porcelain sake flask in a loosely opened black-and-gold kimono exposing her bare shoulders and cleavage, Kuroka props her chin on one hand with a tipsy, playful smile. Warm amber floor lanterns flicker across the room.
data.nsfwProse: She lounges barefoot in a loosely draped black-and-gold silk kimono whose wide collar slips open across her pale bare shoulders, collarbone, and generous cleavage.
